context: docs/evidence/current namespace vs current implementation HEAD
symptom: Evidence files claim db52f9f... and 9eaeec9... while current HEAD is 9c9befd9fe255b0f9271e6e2b8c4bb2443a08089.
root_cause: Evidence pack was not regenerated/rebound to the current observed HEAD after subsequent commits.
failed_approach: Using docs/evidence/current as if directory name implied current proof.
why_failed: Evidence freshness is commit-bound, not directory-name-bound.
declared_recovery: Regenerate/re-execute evidence against exact current HEAD and store exact revision metadata.
prevention: Evidence registry must compare artifact revision to current HEAD before accepting proof.
